headline: Apple TV adds built-in sign language interpretation for original titles
summary: Apple added sign language interpretation as a built-in accessibility feature for a selection of original Apple TV titles.

claims.statement: Apple TV added built-in sign language interpretation for a selection of original titles.

sources.quote: Apple brings Sign Language interpretation to a selection of original Apple TV titles
You'll be able to watch 'Being Heumann,' 'F1' and other original titles with sign language interpretation.
Apple TV makes sign language interpretation a built-in accessibility feature
Apple TV's new accessibility feature lets viewers turn on sign language interpretation within supported titles.
